label: About
title: About Where Crimson Takes Root
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 2 recent saved-signal files and 1 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around Skull and red-flower collage. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Where Crimson Takes Root: Landscape collage across a broad scratched charcoal field. A large skull fragment holds uneven black sockets, a narrow nasal slit and tight triangular teeth; crimson flower islands cross its fibrous edge. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Large left skull-and-crimson-flower collage silhouette, Dark socket apertures and pointed tooth edge within the owning skull fragment, and Fibrous pale material and torn edges integrated with the skull.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
